# 1.1 ARIMA (no breakpoints)

```{r}
#theil's U
theils_u <- function(actual, forecast) {
  # Check inputs
  if (length(actual) != length(forecast)) {
    stop("Actual and forecast vectors must be the same length.")
  }
  
  # Remove any NA pairs
  valid <- complete.cases(actual, forecast)
  actual <- actual[valid]
  forecast <- forecast[valid]
  
  # Model RMSE
  rmse_model <- sqrt(mean((forecast - actual)^2))
  
  # Naive forecast: lagged actual
  naive_forecast <- c(NA, head(actual, -1))
  
  # Align and remove first NA
  actual_naive  <- actual[-1]
  naive_forecast <- naive_forecast[-1]
  
  rmse_naive <- sqrt(mean((naive_forecast - actual_naive)^2))
  
  # Theil's U
  u_stat <- rmse_model / rmse_naive
  return(u_stat)
}

```

```{r}

#arima

#auto
auto.arima(df_ts_train)
#with plots
acf(df_ts_train, main="ACF of Differenced Series")
pacf(df_ts_train, main="PACF of Differenced Series")

model <- arima(df_ts_train, order = c(0, 0, 1))
checkresiduals(model)
resids <- residuals(model, standardize = TRUE)
ArchTest(resids, lags = 12)
summary(model)

h <- 10  # number of years ahead
fc <- forecast(model, h = h)

#Extract the true out‐of‐sample holds
start_fc_time <- time(df_ts_train)[length(df_ts_train)] + deltat(df_ts_train)
true_fc <- window(df_ts, start = start_fc_time, end = start_fc_time + (h - 1) * deltat(df_ts))

#Compute forecast errors
errors <- true_fc - fc$mean
MSFE <- mean(errors^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MAFE <- mean(abs(errors), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("MSFE:", round(MSFE,4), "\n")
cat("MAFE:", round(MAFE,4), "\n")

u <- theils_u(true_fc, fc$mean)
cat("Theil's U-statistic:", round(u, 4), "\n")


model_results <- data.frame(
  Model = "ARIMA",
  MAE = MAFE,
  RMSE = MSFE,
  MAPE = "NA",
  AIC = "NA",
  BIC = "NA"
)


#Prepare data for ggplot
orig_df <- data.frame(
  Year  = as.numeric(time(df_ts)),
  Value = as.numeric(df_ts)
)
fc_df <- data.frame(
  Year      = as.numeric(time(fc$mean)),
  Forecast  = as.numeric(fc$mean),
  Lo80      = as.numeric(fc$lower[,"80%"]),
  Hi80      = as.numeric(fc$upper[,"80%"]),
  Lo95      = as.numeric(fc$lower[,"95%"]),
  Hi95      = as.numeric(fc$upper[,"95%"])
)


# prepare a combined data.frame for easier legend mapping
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  orig_df  %>% mutate(Type = "Actual"),
  fc_df    %>% transmute(Year, Value = Forecast, Type = "Forecast")
)


ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Type, linetype = Type)) +
  # actual vs. forecasted lines
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  # 95% forecast interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = fc_df,
    aes(x = Year, ymin = Lo95, ymax = Hi95),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  # manual color & linetype scales
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "Forecast" = "red")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Actual" = "solid", "Forecast" = "dashed")) +
  # nicer x-axis breaks (integer years)
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(min(plot_df$Year)), ceiling(max(plot_df$Year)), by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Historical Series and 10-Year MA(1) Forecast",
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "Value",
    caption  = "Forecast interval: 95%"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title        = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    legend.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.major    = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks          = element_line(size = 0.5),
    plot.caption        = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1)
  )

```

## 3.1 Unconditional Mean

```{r}
actual_ts <- df_ts
train_ts <- df_ts_train

# Forecast next 10 years (2015–2024)
mean_model <- meanf(train_ts, h = 10, level = c(80, 95))

# Use forecasted levels directly
forecast_levels <- as.numeric(mean_model$mean)
lower_80 <- as.numeric(mean_model$lower[, "80%"])
upper_80 <- as.numeric(mean_model$upper[, "80%"])
lower_95 <- as.numeric(mean_model$lower[, "95%"])
upper_95 <- as.numeric(mean_model$upper[, "95%"])

# Forecast years
forecast_years <- 2015:2024

# Actual values for 2015–2024
actual_vals <- as.numeric(df_ts[16:25])  # Assuming full levels

# Forecast DataFrame
df_forecast <- data.frame(
  Year = forecast_years,
  Forecast = forecast_levels,
  Lower80 = lower_80,
  Upper80 = upper_80,
  Lower95 = lower_95,
  Upper95 = upper_95
)

# Training data (levels): from 2000 to 2014
df_train <- data.frame(
  Year = 2000:2014,
  Value = as.numeric(df_ts[1:15]),
  Type = "Train"
)

# Actual values
df_actual <- data.frame(
  Year = 2015:2024,
  Value = actual_vals,
  Type = "Actual"
)

# Add last training point to actual for continuity
df_actual_extended <- rbind(
  df_train[nrow(df_train), ],
  df_actual
)

```


## 4.1 ARDL

```{r}
#load and summarise dataset

# 1. Select only numeric columns
num_vars <- final_dataset %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# 2. Compute stats for each column
stats_mat <- sapply(num_vars, function(x) {
  jb <- jarque.test(x)
  c(
    Mean            = mean(x,        na.rm = TRUE),
    Median          = median(x,      na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum         = max(x,         na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum         = min(x,         na.rm = TRUE),
    `Std. Dev.`     = sd(x,          na.rm = TRUE),
    Skewness        = skewness(x,    na.rm = TRUE),
    Kurtosis        = kurtosis(x,    na.rm = TRUE),
    `Jarque-Bera`   = as.numeric(jb$statistic),
    Probability     = jb$p.value,
    Sum             = sum(x,         na.rm = TRUE),
    `Sum Sq. Dev.`  = sum((x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Observations    = sum(!is.na(x))
  )
})

# 3. Turn it into a data.frame with one row per statistic
stats_df <- as.data.frame(t(stats_mat)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Statistic")

# 4a. Option 1: using knitr::kable
latex_table <- kable(
  stats_df,
  format    = "latex",
  booktabs  = TRUE,
  digits    = 6,
  caption   = "Table 1: Summary descriptive statistics"
)

cat(latex_table)

```

```{r}
#load the multivariate dataset

datest_diff <- final_dataset  # copy original data frame
non_stationary_vars <- c()



for (col in colnames(final_dataset)) {
  series <- na.omit(final_dataset[[col]])
  
  test_result <- tryCatch({
    adf.test(series)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(test_result) && test_result$p.value > 0.05) {
    # Mark variable as non-stationary
    non_stationary_vars <- c(non_stationary_vars, col)
    
    # Replace the original variable with its first difference
    # Note: diff reduces length by 1, so pad with NA at start for alignment
    diff_series <- c(NA, diff(final_dataset[[col]]))
    
    datest_diff[[col]] <- diff_series
  }
}

# Now datest_diff contains first differences for non-stationary vars, original for others

non_stationary_after_diff <- c()

for (col in colnames(datest_diff)) {
  series <- na.omit(datest_diff[[col]])
  
  test_result <- tryCatch({
    adf.test(series)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(test_result) && !is.na(test_result$p.value) && test_result$p.value > 0.05) {
    non_stationary_after_diff <- c(non_stationary_after_diff, col)
  }
}

# Step 2: Difference those variables again in the dataset
datest_diff2 <- datest_diff  # copy to store second differences

for (col in non_stationary_after_diff) {
  # Second difference: diff of the first-differenced series
  diff_series <- c(NA, diff(datest_diff[[col]]))  # pad NA for alignment
  
  datest_diff2[[col]] <- diff_series
}


non_stationary_after_second_diff <- c()

for (col in colnames(datest_diff2)) {
  series <- na.omit(datest_diff2[[col]])
  
  test_result <- tryCatch({
    adf.test(series)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(test_result) && !is.na(test_result$p.value) && test_result$p.value > 0.05) {
    non_stationary_after_second_diff <- c(non_stationary_after_second_diff, col)
  }
}

non_stationary_after_second_diff

stationary_vars <- setdiff(colnames(datest_diff2), non_stationary_after_second_diff)
stationary_vars

L <- function(x, k) {
  stats::lag(x, -k)
}

# Assuming datest_diff2 is already defined and time-ordered (annual)
data_mult2_train <- datest_diff2[13:25, ]  # Train on 14 years
data_mult2       <- datest_diff2[13:35, ]  # Full data for evaluation (23 years)

# Convert to time series
data_ts_train <- ts(data_mult2_train, start = 2002, frequency = 1)
data_ts_full  <- ts(data_mult2, start = 2002, frequency = 1)

model1 <- auto_ardl(
  inflation ~ unemp + gdp_growth,
  data = data_ts_train,
  max_order = 2,
  selection = "BIC"
)
model1 <- model1$best_model
#checkresiduals(model1)

newdata <- data_mult2[14:nrow(data_mult2), c("inflation", "unemp", "gdp_growth")]

forecast_values <- predict(model1, newdata = newdata, n.ahead = nrow(newdata))
print(forecast_values)

actual_values <- data_mult2$inflation[14:nrow(data_mult2)]

# Forecast errors
errors <- actual_values - forecast_values
MSFE   <- mean(errors^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MAFE   <- mean(abs(errors), na.rm = TRUE)
cat("MSFE:", round(MSFE, 4), "\n")
cat("MAFE:", round(MAFE, 4), "\n\n")
u <- theils_u(actual_values, forecast_values)
cat("Theil's U-statistic:", round(u, 4), "\n")

# 1. Build the “Actual” data.frame
orig_df <- tibble(
  Year  = as.numeric(time(data_ts_full)),
  Value = as.numeric(data_ts_full[, "inflation"]),
  Type  = "Actual"
)

# 2. Figure out the forecast years programmatically
#    (start right after the end of your training sample)
train_length   <- length(time(data_ts_train))     # e.g. 13 years
full_years     <- as.numeric(time(data_ts_full))  # e.g. 2000:2022
forecast_years <- full_years[(train_length + 1):length(full_years)]

# 3. Build the “Forecast” data.frame
fc_df <- tibble(
  Year     = forecast_years,
  Value    = as.numeric(forecast_values),
  Type     = "Forecast"
)

# 4. Combine for plotting
plot_df <- bind_rows(orig_df, fc_df)

# 5. Plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Type, linetype = Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  # ribbon from 0 up to the forecast line:
  geom_ribbon(
    data        = fc_df,
    aes(x = Year, ymin = 0, ymax = Value),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill        = "grey70",
    alpha       = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Actual = "black", Forecast = "red")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Actual = "solid", Forecast = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_df$Year), max(plot_df$Year), by = 1)) +
  labs(
    title   = "Inflation: Actual vs. ARDL Forecast",
    x       = "Year",
    y       = "Inflation Rate",
    caption = "Shaded area: 0 up to forecast"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## 5.1 Benchmark AR(2)

```{r}
# --- Prepare data ---
ts_train <- df_ts_train
t_train <- time(ts_train)

# Structural break dummy (e.g., break in 1999)
break_year <- 1999
dum_train <- as.numeric(t_train >= break_year)

# --- Fit AR(2) model with structural break dummy ---
model_break <- Arima(ts_train,
                     order  = c(2, 0, 0),          # AR(2) model
                     xreg   = dum_train,
                     include.constant = FALSE)

checkresiduals(model_break)

# --- ARCH test on residuals ---
resids <- residuals(model_break, standardize = TRUE)
ArchTest(resids, lags = 12)
summary(model_break)

# --- Forecasting ---

# Create future dummy variable values (for 10-year forecast)
h <- length(df_ts) - length(df_ts_train)
dum_train2 <- rep(1, h)  # Because all future periods are after the break

fc <- forecast(model_break, h = h, xreg = dum_train2)

# --- Extract true values ---
start_fc_time <- time(df_ts_train)[length(df_ts_train)] + deltat(df_ts_train)
true_fc <- window(df_ts, start = start_fc_time, end = start_fc_time + (h - 1) * deltat(df_ts))

# --- Forecast errors ---
errors <- true_fc - fc$mean
MSFE <- mean(errors^2, na.rm = TRUE)
MAFE <- mean(abs(errors), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("MSFE:", round(MSFE, 4), "\n")
cat("MAFE:", round(MAFE, 4), "\n")

u <- theils_u(true_fc, fc$mean)
cat("Theil's U-statistic:", round(u, 4), "\n")

# --- Plotting data preparation ---
orig_df <- data.frame(
  Year  = as.numeric(time(df_ts)),
  Value = as.numeric(df_ts)
)

fc_df <- data.frame(
  Year      = as.numeric(time(fc$mean)),
  Forecast  = as.numeric(fc$mean),
  Lo80      = as.numeric(fc$lower[, "80%"]),
  Hi80      = as.numeric(fc$upper[, "80%"]),
  Lo95      = as.numeric(fc$lower[, "95%"]),
  Hi95      = as.numeric(fc$upper[, "95%"])
)

plot_df <- bind_rows(
  orig_df %>% mutate(Type = "Actual"),
  fc_df   %>% transmute(Year, Value = Forecast, Type = "Forecast")
)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Type, linetype = Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = fc_df,
    aes(x = Year, ymin = Lo95, ymax = Hi95),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black", "Forecast" = "red")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Actual" = "solid", "Forecast" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(min(plot_df$Year)), ceiling(max(plot_df$Year)), by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Historical Series and 10-Year AR(2) Forecast with Structural Break",
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "Value",
    caption  = "Forecast interval: 95%"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title        = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    legend.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
    panel.grid.major    = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks          = element_line(size = 0.5),
    plot.caption        = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1)
  )
```
